entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Abbasid Caliphate, a political institution in Indonesia during Srivijaya Maritime Empire (670–900). Led to the emergence of Kedukan Bukit inscription — earliest evidence of the Srivijayan polity and Srivijaya Decline and Chola Raids.
